const demoMeals = [ { _id: "healthy-1", name: "Healthy Veg Meal", description: "A balanced meal with fresh vegetables, rice and nutritious sides.", price: 199, calories: 420, }, { _id: "healthy-2", name: "Fresh Green Bowl", description: "Fresh greens, vegetables, grains and a light homemade dressing.", price: 229, calories: 350, }, { _id: "healthy-3", name: "Protein Meal Bowl", description: "A satisfying protein-rich meal prepared with fresh ingredients.", price: 269, calories: 480, }, ]; const currency = (value) => `₹${Number(value || 0).toFixed(0)}`; export default function Home() { const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState(0); const [meals, setMeals] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); /* ===================================================== AUTOMATIC HERO ====================================================== */ useEffect(() => { const interval = setInterval(() => { setActiveSlide((current) => (current + 1) % heroSlides.length ); }, 4500); return () => clearInterval(interval); }, []); /* ===================================================== LOAD HEALTHY FOOD MENU ====================================================== */ useEffect(() => { let mounted = true; api .getMenu() .then((data) => { if (!mounted) return; if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) { setMeals(data.slice(0, 6)); } else { setMeals(demoMeals); } setLoading(false); }) .catch(() => { if (!mounted) return; setMeals(demoMeals); setLoading(false); }); return () => { mounted = false; }; }, []); const hero = heroSlides[activeSlide]; return (
